title: Halve-Then-Greedy: Adaptive Sampling for Posterior Success with Near-Optimal Instance Dependence
abstract: arXiv:2610.20997v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study fixed-budget adaptive experimentation aimed at maximizing the probability of obtaining sufficient posterior evidence that a recommended design's mean performance exceeds a target. Unlike best-arm identification, this objective does not require finding the best design. For Gaussian bandits with a Gaussian prior, we propose \emph{Halve-Then-Greedy} (HTG), which combines a large initial balanced allocation, successive halving, and posterior-greedy sampling. We prove instance-dependent, finite-budget exponential bounds on posterior-failure probability that capture both separation from unfavorable arms and the presence of multiple favorable arms. On one-positive-arm families, we establish an asymptotic sample-complexity lower bound that HTG matches up to a logarithmic factor. We further analyze uniform sampling and sequential halving, revealing regimes where they require more samples than HTG by linear and logarithmic factors, resp

translated_title: 先减半后贪心：具有近最优实例依赖性的后验成功自适应采样
translated_abstract: 我们研究固定预算下的自适应实验问题，旨在最大化获得充分后验证据的概率，即推荐设计的均值表现超过目标值。与最优臂识别不同，该目标无需找到最优设计。对于具有高斯先验的高斯老虎机问题，我们提出了“先减半后贪心”（HTG）算法，该算法结合了大规模初始均衡分配、逐次减半和后验贪心采样。我们证明了后验失败概率的实例依赖、有限预算指数界，该界同时刻画了与不利臂的分离程度以及多个有利臂的存在。在单正臂问题上，我们建立了渐近样本复杂度下界，HTG 在相差一个对数因子的范围内与之匹配。我们进一步分析了均匀采样和逐次减半方法，揭示了在某些情形下它们分别需要比 HTG 多出线性因子和对数因子数量的样本。
tldr: 提出“先减半后贪心”（HTG）自适应采样算法，在固定预算下最大化推荐设计表现超过目标的后验证据概率，并证明了实例依赖的指数级失败概率界，其样本复杂度在单正臂情形下达到近最优（仅差一个对数因子）。
